facts.fact: The Ministry of the Interior playbook says ANCE/TunTrust acts as root certification authority, with decrees of 2000-2001 setting the conditions for accrediting certification service providers.

The playbook lists E-Houwiya as integrated by services of many bodies, including the transport and communications ministry portals, education, CNAM, CNSS, the business register, Tunisie Telecom, five named banks and La Poste.

The playbook says the Mobile ID gives simple, secure access to digital services, and gives +450K Mobile IDs linked to a phone number and +35K linked to devices, with electronic signature of documents and contracts in the citizen portal.
